subject: Commitment cadence: capacity bump & payment lane alignment
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Ava Thompson <ava.thompson@bluehaven.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Commitment cadence: capacity bump & payment lane alignment

Hi Ava —

Congrats again on the renewal decision — excited to keep Bluehaven running on Redwood. As discussed on the call, we'll add the additional 400k tokens/month capacity (effective 2027-05-01) and roll the term into the annual renewal. To get the order processed this quarter we need:

- PO referencing deal BH-2027-Q2-007
- Billing contact for AP (name, email, PO instructions)
- Any tax forms for the payor entity (W-9/W-8BEN as applicable)
- Confirmation of payment terms (your note on Friday mentioned Net60 — please confirm)

If you attach the PO I can route to our billing team and get a DocuSign amendment out the same day. We can provision the capacity as soon as the PO is received and routed.

Thanks — I’ve CC'd Marissa for upstream renewal visibility and Ben for finance handoff.

Best,

--
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Renewals | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

[Attachment: pricing_summary_2027-04.pdf (pdf)]

From: Ava Thompson <ava.thompson@bluehaven.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@bluehaven.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-18T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Commitment cadence: capacity bump & payment lane alignment

Hi Soojin —

Thanks — attaching our PO (Bluehaven_PO_007.pdf). A few notes from procurement:

- PO includes the extra capacity line item and references BH-2027-Q2-007.
- We need the billing contact for the invoice to be: Finance Ops <procurement@bluehaven.ai>.
- Bluehaven requires Net60 on new vendors; please confirm Redwood can accept Net60 for this renewal amendment.
- I’m also attaching a signed W-9 for our vendor records (Bluehaven_W9_signed.pdf) — please confirm receipt.

If Net60 requires an approval flow on your side, let me know the expected timing so we can align. We'd like provisioning to start 2027-05-01 if possible.

Thanks,
Ava

[Attachment: Bluehaven_PO_007.pdf (pdf), Bluehaven_W9_signed.pdf (pdf)]

Ben / Soojin — forwarding Bluehaven's PO and W-9. Procurement is requesting Net60 for the amendment. Quick questions for finance:

- Is Net60 acceptable for BH-2027-Q2-007 given they're a long-standing account (on annual prepay previously, now moving to invoiced renewal)?
- Any outstanding credit or billing holds against Bluehaven?
- If finance approves Net60, can we schedule provisioning for 2027-05-01 with a conditional note that services bill on a Net60 cycle?

Ben — cc'd Soojin so she can relay timing back to the customer. Please reply with the approval and any paperwork (SLA/credit memo) we should add to the HubSpot deal.

Soojin / Marissa —

We reviewed Bluehaven's PO and W-9. Finance approves Net60 for this amendment on the following conditions:

1) Procurement's contact (procurement@bluehaven.ai) must be listed as the billing recipient on the invoice.
2) A short amendment (DocuSign) must be executed referencing BH-2027-Q2-007 and the Net60 payment term. I’ve created the DocuSign envelope (link below) and added a billing memo to the invoice template.
3) No prior unpaid invoices older than 30 days exist in their ledger; current ledger status is clean.

Soojin — please send the DocuSign amendment link to Ava and confirm the billing contact as Finance Ops <procurement@bluehaven.ai>. Once the signed amendment returns, we can proceed with provisioning on 2027-05-01 and route the invoice on Net60 terms (invoice date = provisioning start).

Ben
